task: Pick up the kiwi from the table and place it in the center of the table.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the kiwi, and its tip is about 5 cm away from the kiwi.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the kiwi, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the kiwi and about 10 cm away from the center of the table.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the kiwi so that it now rests in the center of the table.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the kiwi from the table.
The gripper places the kiwi in the center of the table.
